parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: Rule ID, limited to executing rules of **RuleType** **BACKUP**.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
Data source type, with the value range as follows:

- **UDM_ECS**: Represents ECS full machine backup.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr execute-policy-v2 --policy-id po-000000000000000hky --data-source-id i-bp1000000000000dtv --source-type UDM_ECS --rule-id rule-000200000ux8 --region cn-hangzhou
